# ostree / fuzz-bootconfig

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `fuzz-bootconfig` ([source](source/fuzz-bootconfig.c), unmodified) over ostree (ostreedev/ostree at 1d5a312a).

Writes the input to a temp bootloader-entry file (optionally using a '+'-prefixed input prefix as the tries-counter filename suffix), parses it with ostree_bootconfig_parser_parse_at, calls the tries/get getters, writes it back with ostree_bootconfig_parser_write_at and clones it; every result and error is discarded. The written-back file is never re-parsed or compared (a parse->write->parse roundtrip was available but not checked).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ostree at commit 1d5a312a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
